text: Owner decision 2026-09-17: 1.0 is NOT text-only; video recall is in scope for 1.0. Consequence: this slice (heterogeneous EvidenceSupport through acquisition, compiler and StoryModel) must land before the 1.0 signature freeze of StoryModel and AlignmentSource; no deprecation-path alternative. T7 publishability is therefore blocked on D1A as well as on the owner's coordinate decisions. Coordinate decision, same day: stay under bbuchsbaum (remote and gh auth already are; build.sbt organization io.github.canardlapin and the tlGitHubDev entry move to bbuchsbaum under T7).
